Influence on India's Freedom Struggle and Development Strategy

Recent discussions explore the historical influences on India's path to independence and its subsequent development. One perspective examines the role of American figures, such as Jefferson, in shaping India's freedom struggle. Another viewpoint focuses on how the freedom struggle itself influenced India's post-independence development strategy. These analyses highlight different aspects of the foundational period of modern India.
